name: @projexlight/connector-gworkspace
summary: Google Workspace connector: domain-wide OAuth install, Drive sync, Calendar event handling, Gmail send via Workspace API. Counterpart to connector-microsoft365 for tenants on Google Workspace; same composition pattern with sdk-search + sdk-media + sdk-notification.

events.name: connector-gworkspace.mail.sent.v1
events.description: Outbound mail sent via Gmail API.

hooks.name: installConnector
hooks.description: Domain-wide OAuth install + service-account JSON storage.

hooks.name: sendMail
hooks.description: Send mail via Gmail API as the impersonated user.

hooks.name: handleWatchPush
hooks.description: Process Drive / Gmail / Calendar push-notification (watch endpoint).

scenarios.title: Workspace super-admin grants domain-wide delegation
scenarios.when_to_use: First install. Super-admin pastes the service account's client_id into Workspace Admin → API Controls → Domain-wide delegation; we record the auth + verify impersonation works.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Install row + vault-wrapped service-account JSON. Test impersonation hits Drive successfully.

scenarios.title: Sync a shared Drive folder into the file cache
scenarios.when_to_use: Compliance ask: every doc in the 'Q2-Contracts' shared drive indexed locally for sdk-search.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Changed files synced; metadata cached + optionally bytes pulled into sdk-media. .drive_file.synced.v1 per file.

scenarios.title: Send customer email as the sales rep (Gmail API)
scenarios.when_to_use: Outbound mail must appear in the rep's Gmail Sent folder + thread with prior conversation. Domain-wide delegation impersonates the rep.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Mail sent + threaded. Emits .mail.sent.v1. sdk-audit chain pins the impersonated subject.

scenarios.title: Calendar push-notification updates the encounter
scenarios.when_to_use: Drive / Calendar push-notification fires; we update linked ProjexCloud entities. Google watch tokens expire — scheduler renews them weekly.
scenarios.example_code:
import { handleWatchPush } from '@projexlight/connector-gworkspace';
await handleWatchPush({ tenant_id, resource: 'calendar', headers: req.headers });

scenarios.title: Scheduler renews Google watch tokens before expiry
scenarios.when_to_use: Google watch subscriptions expire after a week; scheduler renews 24h before expiry so no push notifications get missed.
scenarios.example_code: // driven by startScheduler — weekly renew pass.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Watch tokens refreshed silently; install row's watch_expires_at advances.

compliance_posture.notes: Service-account JSON vault-wrapped. Domain-wide delegation requires super-admin consent + a posted audit log entry. EU domains pin to EU API regions where Google offers them.
